svg.title: One job, one sweep
svg.desc: Top: one job from add() to completed. The producer bounds every enqueue to 3 s and refuses at once while Redis is down, so a request never hangs; the hashed dedupe key drops a repeat of the same job; the queue policy's jittered exponential backoff spaces retries, so a failed attempt goes back through it instead of retrying in a storm; a JobHost worker runs the job and calls its final-failure hook once. Bottom: one sweep declared on two replicas. Both upsert the same scheduler, Redis holds one, and each tick runs once rather than once per replica.
